institutional_scope: U.S. District Court, Eastern District of Michigan

remedy.notes: On June 28, 2024, the district court dismissed all claims with prejudice by stipulation and retained jurisdiction for four years to enforce the settlement (ECF 73). The agreement requires Detroit police to implement the revised facial-recognition directive. It puts damages, fees and costs in a separately redacted release.
